title: v2.8.2 - Loop not executing every 5 mins even when a TB needs changing
symptom: Loop is not executing every 5 mins even though a TB needs changing. Manually pressing 'run now' or setting a new action like a TT makes the loop run. Autosens seems to be changing value with each new BG.
cause: The root cause is too much concurrent changes in DB which is preventing AS calculation to finish.
fix: The issue cannot be resolved in version 2.8. The user is advised to wait for version 3.0 where this has been improved.
evidence_quote: the root cause is too much concurrent changes in DB which is preventing AS calculation to finish. I'm unable to resolve it in 2.8 In 3.0 this has been improved a lot
